snippet.title: Foodslingers Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Cook, run, jump, and serve — all in the name of keeping your customers happy. This chaotic, comedic spin on the classic cooking formula demands speed, strategy, and just the right amount of panic! Team up with up to 4 friends and try to run the restaurant smoothly... or let it all go up in flames.

Steam Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2145460/Foodslingers/

Join the community!
https://discord.gg/WvQKEUu2Bg
